Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — A news article on the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. It features warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire, making it feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com. It's a nice, clean introduction — it clearly identifies it as your personal site and makes it easy to get in touch via email. My feedback: it feels a bit sparse, so you could make it more engaging by adding a short bio, a photo, and a few links to your work or projects you're proud of. That would give visitors a better sense of who you are and what you do. Great start though — it's clear and approachable!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com. It's a lovely personal blog, and I love that you share your passion for hiking — that personal touch makes it feel warm and authentic. My feedback: adding a few recent blog posts with photos from your hikes, plus some details like trail difficulty, distance, and best seasons, would make it much more useful and engaging for fellow hikers. A short "about me" section and links to your favorite gear or routes would be a great finishing touch. Keep up the great work!
